security_probation_001.evidence: (1) 'Career educator' means a licensed employee who has a reasonable expectation of continued employment under the policies of a local school board. (3) 'Probationary educator' means an educator employed by a school district who, under local school board policy, has been advised by the district that the educator's performance is inadequate. (4) 'Provisional educator' means an educator employed by a school district who has not achieved status as a career educator within the school district.

security_rif_006.answer: District-wide RIF applies when the District cannot place teachers after surplus before the new contract year. Requires a 10-day meeting with the Association. Unplaced teachers are reviewed by endorsements, certifications, and staffing needs; tie-breakers use advanced degree and lane placement. Released teachers get a 6-month first right of interview, notified by certified letter with 7 days to accept/reject.
